# Bamboozle

> Bamboozle is a fast, lightweight, language-agnostic HTTP mock server for integration tests and CI.

Bamboozle runs separate mock (`:8080`) and control (`:9090`) HTTP surfaces. Routes can return dynamic responses, record calls, assert on requests, and simulate state, latency, or faults. The project is pre-1.0 and intended only for controlled testing environments.

Run the Docker image, then open `http://localhost:9090/` for the generated interactive API reference.

## Documentation

- [Project overview and quick start](https://github.com/matt-andrews/Bamboozle/blob/main/README.md): Purpose, feature summary, and a minimal working example.
- [Configuration](https://github.com/matt-andrews/Bamboozle/blob/main/docs/configuration.md): Static routes, limits, logging, telemetry, and TLS.
- [CEL assertion expressions](https://github.com/matt-andrews/Bamboozle/blob/main/docs/expression-syntax.md): Variables, methods, macros, and operators for filtering recorded calls.

## Examples

- [Executable example catalogue](https://github.com/matt-andrews/Bamboozle/blob/main/examples/README.md): Run realistic mock APIs with Docker Compose.
- [Example route configurations](https://github.com/matt-andrews/Bamboozle/tree/main/examples/routes): JSON and YAML demonstrations of supported features.
